# Manus Phase 3 Evidence Package

**Task date:** 2026-08-25 (Asia/Shanghai)

## Scope

This package is for the four and only four Phase 3 tasks assigned in `/home/ubuntu/upload/pasted_content.txt`:

1. Page-Level Control Delta Ledger;
2. Character Memory Long-Run Generalization;
3. App Runtime State Migration Edge Matrix; and
4. Maps `有底图` versus `全部` catalog set difference.

All browser-derived observations must come from normal visible WorldOS UI. Every claim requires identity, URL, time, object or simulation identifier where applicable, preconditions, action, visible feedback, before/after state, reload persistence, evidence path, confidence and known boundary. Results use the Phase 3 vocabulary: `CONFIRMED`, `DISCOVERED_ONLY`, `TRIGGERED`, `NOT_VERIFIED`, `BLOCKED`, `MEMBERSHIP_BLOCKED`, `TOOLING_BLOCKED`, or `UNKNOWN`.

## Safety and non-duplication guardrails

Only new `MANUS-P3-*` objects may be created, edited, published, run, updated or deleted. No payment, Credits, subscription, API key, hidden API, browser storage inspection/manipulation, security test, stress test, third-party mutation, or non-P3 mutation is in scope. No Phase 1 App Gift/App discovery or Phase 2 Creator validation, responsive, non-App discovery, locale/routing, or App Market-category census will be rerun.

## Existing-material inputs

The prescribed local files `docs/worldos-research/ux/PAGE_CONTROL_AUDIT.md`, `docs/worldos-research/02_FULL_SITE_MAP.md`, `docs/worldos-research/03_RESEARCH_COVERAGE.md`, `docs/worldos-research/maps/MAP_SYSTEM.md`, and `docs/worldos-research/maps/MAP_LIFECYCLE_RELATIONSHIPS.md` were not found under `/home/ubuntu` at Phase 3 setup. This is recorded as an **input-availability limitation**, not a claim that their coverage does not exist. The ledger will separately mark prior Manus P1/P2 coverage from their locally available reports and will not reconstruct a full site audit.

## Expected evidence structure

- `screenshots/` — visible UI screenshot captures.
- `raw/` — copied page text, state observations or captured data tables.
- `assets/` — harmless local fixtures only.
- `MANUS_P3_*` files — final task-specific reports, CSVs, chronology, evidence index and cleanup manifest.

## Cleanup states

Every `MANUS-P3-*` remote object will end as `CLEANED`, `ALREADY_ABSENT`, `CLEANUP_BLOCKED`, or `RETAINED_FOR_EVIDENCE + reason`. A timeout, no feedback or unexplained navigation never counts as `CLEANED`.
